festivals.name: Daisy Chain Fields (Olivia Rodrigo)
festivals.location: Great Park Live, Irvine (OC — ~45 mi, worth the drive)
festivals.why: Olivia Rodrigo's first festival — a one-day, all-women lineup (Chappell Roan, Doechii, Mitski, The Breeders, Bikini Kill, Garbage, Santigold + special guests Stevie Nicks, Karen O, Sarah McLachlan), 100% of net proceeds to women/girls nonprofits. Off the core house/techno lane, but a marquee must-know — and squarely on-taste for the Lori profile (she tracks Olivia Rodrigo + Mitski). Sold out; only path in now is the L.A. Works volunteer-drive ticket lottery (125 pairs) or resale.

festivals.name: Sun Soaked 2026 (Kaskade)
festivals.why: Kaskade's one-day beach party, back via Insomniac — Bunt. b2b Kaskade, Cassian, D.O.D, Matroda; tech/progressive house on the sand, noon–9pm, 18+. Big-room end of the house lane, but sand-underfoot day-party is squarely the setting. GA from ~$110. Sold on a white-label Front Gate storefront the TM API doesn't carry — 19hz is the catalog source.

festivals.name: CRSSD Festival — Fall 2026
festivals.why: SD is a drive, but this is festival-tier and on-taste — Disclosure, Chris Lake, Groove Armada (DJ set), Helena Hauff, Ben UFO, I Hate Models, Mathame, Carlita, salute. House/ techno/melodic, European lean, waterfront, 21+. NOTE: same weekend as Portola (SF) — can't do both; pick one.

festivals.name: Portola 2026
festivals.why: THE one for you — electronic-forward with DESPACIO (James Murphy + 2ManyDJs sound system), Four Tet, Soulwax, Groove Armada, DJ Shadow, Fatboy Slim, Skepta, plus Robyn, Tiësto, Swedish House Mafia. European/house energy in a warehouse-pier setting. 2-day ~$380.

festivals.name: Coachella 2027
festivals.why: Advance GA already sold out (~$549–599); lineup typically drops Sept 2026–Jan 2027. Worth tracking the lineup announce to decide if a resale is worth it.

festivals.name: GALA Festival (London) — 2027 edition
festivals.why: Quintessential European house/disco day-fest (2026: Seth Troxler, Todd Terje, Call Super, DJ Seinfeld). On-taste, but not timely — only bubble up when 2027 presale/lineup drops.

events.title: BAUGRUPPE90, Coffintexts, Trax Unit, Newty
events.detail: Underground giant INCOGNITO celebrates 20 years in the business with a slew of heavy-hitting names who reflect the best of dance music today.
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

sounds_like: Roni Size & Reprazent's 'New Forms' era jungle

artist_notes.name: Roni Size
artist_notes.note: British jungle/drum-and-bass pioneer — Reprazent's Mercury Prize-winning 'New Forms' (1997) is a genre landmark; a genuine dnb legend outside the usual festival circuit.

artist_notes.name: Dieselboy
artist_notes.note: US drum-and-bass mainstay since the '90s, key to breaking the sound stateside (Human Imprint) — breakbeat-heavy, high-energy sets.

artist_notes.name: BAUGRUPPE90
artist_notes.note: German techno duo (Louis Köhler & Paul Vogler) fusing 90s dnb/house/early-2000s-techno textures into a driving, industrial-leaning sound — releases on Sous Music, Steel City Dance Discs, and their own MONTAGE imprint.

artist_notes.name: Coffintexts
artist_notes.note: Miami producer (Alexandra Muggli, Peruvian heritage) blending UK-style techno with bass-heavy, tempo-shifting global rhythms — hardgroove and tribal-house leaning, a rising RA-radar name.

artist_notes.name: Trax Unit
artist_notes.note: LA underground techno duo (Kyle Galindo & Kian Mahroo), Dublab residents who run the local Gyration Station label — stripped-down, analog-grit techno, an actual local scene name rather than a touring import.

enrichment.curator_note: This isn't the vinyl-and-rooftop lane — it's INCOGNITO's 20th-anniversary warehouse weekend, hardgroove techno sliding into full-tilt drum & bass, with actual scene royalty (Roni Size, Dieselboy) instead of the usual local bill. Worth it if you want proof LA's underground rave scene still has teeth.
enrichment.description: INCOGNITO's 20th-anniversary warehouse weekend (TBA location, Sep 4-5) spans hardgroove techno and drum & bass, headlined by dnb legends Roni Size and Dieselboy, with BAUGRUPPE90, Coffintexts, Trax Unit, and residents Newty and WHYS.

sounds_like: eclectic global house/disco selections, viral Boiler Room Tokyo energy

artist_notes.name: Powder
artist_notes.note: Tokyo DJ/producer Momoko 'Moko' Goto — eclectic, colorful disco/house/pop selector known for a widely-circulated Boiler Room Tokyo set.

artist_notes.name: DJ Healthy
artist_notes.note: NY-via-Tokyo selector, founder of the PACIFIC MODE party series — tripped-out house and tech.

enrichment.curator_note: A four-hour open-to-close set from Powder is the draw — she's one of the more genuinely fun, unpredictable selectors on the international circuit, not just a Boiler Room moment.

artist_notes.name: Reiko Takahashi
artist_notes.note: Also performs as Rayko — cut the now-cult 1987 city-pop single 'Sunset Road,' then vanished from music for decades. events.title: TUNNEL presents: DJ Gigola, Annie Lew, Etari & OZA
events.detail: Live From Earth's DJ Gigola is a fan favourite for her ravey take on acid, breaks and pop. Get a taste of her playful approach to club music.
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: DJ Gigola
artist_notes.note: Berlin's Paulina Schulz, part of the Live From Earth collective — genre-fluid sets sliding between trance, gabber, acid, breaks and pop, honed at rooms like Berghain; a real European club import, not a tourist booking.

artist_notes.name: Annie Lew
artist_notes.note: LA-based rising techno DJ/producer, an Infra and TUNNEL resident — tension-built, hypnotic, rhythm-first sets.

artist_notes.name: Etari
artist_notes.note: LA producer (Alixandria Andre) — hypnotic house and broken-beat selector who's played Lights Down Low and Incognito and a HÖR Berlin set; Yellow Island Records.

artist_notes.name: OZA
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn-born, LA-based DJ/producer and TUNNEL founder — high-energy sets blending hard house, breaks and techno; the promoter as much as the performer here.

enrichment.curator_note: DJ Gigola's Berghain-honed acid-into-breaks style is the real draw — a genuine European club import at a proper TBA warehouse afterhours, backed by a deep TUNNEL resident bench in Annie Lew, Etari and OZA.
enrichment.description: TUNNEL presents Berlin's DJ Gigola with residents Annie Lew, Etari and OZA at a TBA LA location, 11pm-6am.

events.title: Studio Barnhus Summer Dance Party with Axel Boman, Kornel Kovacs, Nikki Nair
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Axel Boman
artist_notes.note: Swedish producer and Studio Barnhus co-founder — playful, eclectic deep house with a loose, jammy feel (his 'Purple Drank' and marathon festival sets are genre-defining); this is basically his label's home-turf party.

artist_notes.name: Kornél Kovács
artist_notes.note: Studio Barnhus co-founder alongside Axel Boman — bright, melodic, disco-tinged house; one of the most purely fun-first DJs in the European house scene.

artist_notes.name: Nikki Nair
artist_notes.note: Atlanta producer/DJ blending techno, electro, breaks and UK bass into something genre-agnostic and physical — releases on Dirtybird and Lobster Theremin, mentored early by Underground Resistance's Mike Banks.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based selector who co-founded Dig Deeper LA and co-runs Take It Outside — cosmic disco, deep house and left-field selections.

artist_notes.name: Tottie
artist_notes.note: Dublab-affiliated LA radio host and co-founder of SOS Music, a !K7-backed label/platform spotlighting women and non-binary electronic artists.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control, Machine Club lineage) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

enrichment.curator_note: Both Studio Barnhus co-founders in one room for an outdoor day party is the label doing exactly what it does best — warm, playful house that doesn't take itself too seriously. Nikki Nair going way outside that lane only makes the bill more interesting.
enrichment.description: Studio Barnhus label showcase at The Bridge, DTLA, with co-founders Axel Boman and Kornél Kovács plus Nikki Nair, Masha Mar, Tottie and Stacy Christine (Sat 9/5, 5pm).

events.title: Bears In Space Season Closer Lot Party
reasons: +3 event card (+1 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Lovefingers
artist_notes.note: Andrew Hogge — LA Balearic/disco digger and shaman of ESP Institute, the label/party he's run for two decades; longtime DJ Harvey collaborator in the same cosmic-disco lineage.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector out of the '90s UK queer rave scene — house/techno/disco marathon sets and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator/muse.

artist_notes.name: Bears In Space
artist_notes.note: The LA collective throwing this one — Chris Bowen and Victor Rodriguez have run it since 2009, one of the city's longest-standing queer disco/house day parties, historically pulling guests like DJ Harvey and Horse Meat Disco.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

artist_notes.name: Cocteautwinks
artist_notes.note: LA all-vinyl DJ (Mino Sanchez) — a local cult favorite mixing '90s nostalgia with queer/alternative sensibility; visual artist as much as selector.

enrichment.curator_note: The lineup is legit — Lovefingers and Heidi Lawden are both real DJ Harvey-orbit diggers, not filler — but this is a queer disco day party down to its bones, not a rooftop-groove afternoon that happens to skew that way.
enrichment.description: Outdoor season-closer lot party for Bears in Space, the long-running queer disco day party at Akbar, with ESP Institute's Lovefingers and Balearic/house selector Heidi Lawden.

events.title: Made To Move 8 Year Anniversary: Akumen, agraybe, Andy Oro, No Pressure
reasons: +3 event card (+1 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Akumen
artist_notes.note: Chinatown-based LA house/techno/disco DJ-producer and Made to Move co-founder — releases on Fortune Signal and Juke Bounce Werk, played BBC Radio 1, Rinse FM, and NTS.

artist_notes.name: agraybé
artist_notes.note: LA/Minnesota DJ (Ariana Gray Bé), part of the Made to Move orbit — psychedelic, groove-forward house selections; releases via Kajunga.

artist_notes.name: Andy Oro
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, host of the Oro Hour on VPN Radio and a Made to Move resident — eclectic underground/house sets pulling from DIY dance music, hip-hop and bloghouse.

artist_notes.name: Dj Kerry
artist_notes.note: LA DJ since 2005, longtime Dublab radio host and founder of The Basement, a membership-based party rooted in Paradise Garage/West Coast warehouse tradition.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

artist_notes.name: Rivussy
artist_notes.note: River Collins — non-binary Afro-Caribbean DJ out of LA/North Long Beach blending techno, ghetto house, vogue and club music.

enrichment.curator_note: Nine deep on the bill and the anchor names are genuinely real — Akumen's the co-founder, and Kerry, Stacy Christine, Xica Soul and agraybé are all legit LA underground-house selectors, not padding for a free anniversary flyer.
enrichment.description: Free 8-year-anniversary party for Made to Move, the LA house night, with a stacked local lineup including Akumen, agraybé, Andy Oro and DJ Kerry at General Lee's Cocktail House.

events.title: Midnight Lovers with Massimiliano Pagliara, Masha Mar, James Axon

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer with residencies at Berghain/Basement — Chicago house, Italo-disco and electro-disco worked through analog '70s/'80s hardware; a genuine Live at Robert Johnson / Ostgut Ton pedigree, deeply in the European lane.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ (dublab resident, 'Hearing Color') and founder of the queer underground party Planet Love — deep house, dreamy techno, Italo, Balearic and psych-disco; a real musician's ear (former pianist), has played alongside Octo Octa, Eris Drew, Derrick Carter.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

enrichment.curator_note: Massimiliano Pagliara headlining Midnight Lovers is a legitimate European-club booking — Berghain-lineage electro-disco with Masha Mar and James Axon rounding it out with LA's own deep-house/dublab crowd. This is the kind of night the fabric-London comparison is actually built for.
enrichment.description: Midnight Lovers presents Berlin's Massimiliano Pagliara at The Bridge, DTLA, with Masha Mar and James Axon, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: D.Dan
artist_notes.note: Berlin-based techno DJ/producer, Mala Junta resident and Berghain-circuit name — raw, hypnotic, low-end-heavy techno with none of the retro-revival stuff; rising fast in the European club scene.

enrichment.curator_note: TBA-location, open-to-close solo set from a genuine Berlin techno up-and-comer — this is the afterhours-warehouse lane the taste is built around, and D.Dan is a real name to catch before he's playing bigger rooms.
enrichment.description: WORK presents an all-night, location-TBA solo techno set from Berlin's D.Dan (Mala Junta).

events.title: Deborah De Luca, Anne Futagami, Knox

artist_notes.name: Deborah De Luca
artist_notes.note: Naples-born global techno headliner, dubbed the 'Queen of Naples' — hypnotic, hard-hitting techno on her own Sola_mente Records; a regular DJ Mag Top 100 name and legit festival mainstage act.

artist_notes.name: Anne Futagami
artist_notes.note: Possibly the Tokyo techno/house DJ known for playing guitar over her sets, released on Dirtybird alongside Shinichi Osawa — couldn't confirm it's the same artist booked here, so treat with caution.

enrichment.curator_note: Deborah De Luca is a legitimate global techno headliner — Sola_mente label boss, hard and hypnotic — playing a proper club instead of a festival mainstage; the listing's 'trance/psytrance' genre tag reads like a mismatch, this is a techno night.
enrichment.description: Global techno headliner Deborah De Luca (Sola_mente Records) plays Exchange LA with Anne Futagami and Knox.

events.title: Baile World ft Jyoty, Cquestt, Mango & Ginger, Dj Nico
events.genre: reggaeton, dembow, gqom, baile funk, miami bass, jersey club

artist_notes.name: Jyoty
artist_notes.note: Indian-Dutch, London-based — Rinse FM resident and Boiler Room regular known for blending baile funk, amapiano, dancehall, jungle and UK garage into one set. Not house/techno, but a legitimately international name for a warehouse booking.

artist_notes.name: Cquestt
artist_notes.note: Courtney Hollinquest — LA native, ex-touring backup dancer turned DJ who founded Baile World in 2020 as an Afro-Latina-led party fusing baile funk, reggaeton, dancehall and Black club music.

artist_notes.name: Mango & Ginger
artist_notes.note: Brazil-by-way-of-LA DJ duo built around baile funk and Afro-diasporic rhythms; best known for NYC's 'Favela Fridays' at SOB's, also play regularly on the LA/Baile World circuit.

enrichment.curator_note: This is warehouse energy but not really the house/techno lane — it's baile funk, dancehall, and global-club selecting. Jyoty's the real draw here (Rinse FM resident, plays the rooms that matter), and Cquestt built Baile World from nothing into a real thing, so the selection will be sharp even off-lane.
enrichment.description: Baile funk, dancehall and global-club warehouse party in DTLA headlined by London's Jyoty, with Baile World founder Cquestt, duo Mango & Ginger, and Dj Nico.

artist_notes.name: 2ManyDJs
artist_notes.note: Belgian brothers David & Stephen Dewaele (aka Soulwax) — legendary 2000s bootleg-mashup mix series 'As Heard On Radio Soulwax'; disco/electro/indie-rock blends on their own Deewee label, still a real festival-level draw two decades on.

artist_notes.name: Corey Sizemore
artist_notes.note: LA/SF DJ, co-founder and resident of Lights Down Low alongside Richie Panic; eclectic house-and-techno sets, Boiler Room alum.

artist_notes.name: Richie Panic
artist_notes.note: Founder of Lights Down Low (also Frisco Disco, Blow Up) — the LA promoter behind this exact series, known for genre-blurring 'weird' house and techno bills.

enrichment.curator_note: 2ManyDJs still throw the same bootleg-mashup fire that built their name twenty years ago, now stuffed into an unannounced DTLA warehouse — LDL knows how to build a night around a real headliner instead of just another local bill.
enrichment.description: Belgian bootleg-mashup legends 2ManyDJs headline Lights Down Low's unannounced DTLA warehouse rave with residents Corey Sizemore and Richie Panic.

events.title: Negativland + SUE-C w/ Irene Moon, DJ Professor Cantaloupe
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +2 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Negativland
artist_notes.note: Bay Area culture-jamming/plunderphonics collective since 1980 — pioneered sample-collage sound art and became infamous for the 1991 'U2' single lawsuit that helped define modern fair-use law; runs their own Seeland Records. A genuinely legendary, rarely-touring cult act.

artist_notes.name: SUE-C
artist_notes.note: Bay Area audiovisual artist and Negativland's longtime visual collaborator — live, hands-on analog video/optical processing built to run alongside their sound collage.

artist_notes.name: Irene Moon
artist_notes.note: Alter ego of entomologist-turned-performance-artist Katja Seltmann — absurdist sound/performance art blending science, music and theater; a fixture of the West Coast experimental circuit.

artist_notes.name: DJ Professor Cantaloupe
artist_notes.note: Mitchell Brown — longtime KXLU voice and west-coast noise/experimental scene veteran (Points of Friction, Melon Expander label); pioneered the ambient sample-collage 'Glossolalia' radio show.

enrichment.curator_note: Negativland pioneered sample-collage culture-jamming back when the U2 lawsuit made them infamous, and they almost never play LA — SUE-C's live visual processing plus Irene Moon and DJ Professor Cantaloupe make this one of the stranger, better-programmed nights at a venue you already love.
enrichment.description: Legendary plunderphonics/culture-jamming act Negativland debuts new AV show 'Significantly Less Deceptive' with visual collaborator SUE-C, plus Irene Moon and DJ Professor Cantaloupe.

artist_notes.name: Bayymack
artist_notes.note: LA-based artist blending hip-hop, pop and rock (alt-hip-hop/'scene' crossover — collabs with 6arelyhuman, Lil Raven) — not a DJ/producer in the house-techno sense.

enrichment.curator_note: This reads as a Y2K/'scene'-revival night built around Bayymack's hip-hop-pop, not a house or techno booking — fun if you're into that throwback-emo-rap aesthetic, but it's not really your lane despite the late-night 1720 slot.
enrichment.description: Late-night (10pm) Y2K-themed 'scene' party at 1720 in the Arts District with alt-hip-hop artist Bayymack.

events.title: body wave: Felix Dickinson (UK), Masha Mar, Junior

artist_notes.name: Felix Dickinson
artist_notes.note: UK DJ/producer out of the early-90s free-party scene — deep, chuggy, acid-tinged disco and house; runs Cynic Music, holds residencies at Glastonbury's Block9 and Houghton. A real European-disco-underground name, not a tourist booking.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (Dig Deeper LA, Take It Outside, the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — cosmic disco, deep house, Italo and left-field edits. She's a core-tier artist on your Spotify affinity, worth weighing that in on top of the booking itself.

enrichment.curator_note: Felix Dickinson's chuggy, dub-inflected disco is the UK-import half of this booking, but Masha Mar — one of your heaviest-played artists per your Spotify feedback — running her regular body wave series is the real reason to go; TBA venue is standard for this crew, not a red flag.
enrichment.description: UK disco selector Felix Dickinson headlines the recurring body wave party in DTLA, with Masha Mar and Junior (TBA venue, Sat 9/19).

artist_notes.note: Buenos Aires-born DJ/producer, DJing professionally since 2011 with European tours behind him — dub- and jazz-informed digging across UK/US house, electro and techno; co-runs the Cure Music label.

artist_notes.name: Cromie
artist_notes.note: Zagreb-born, LA-based producer — Balearic-fringe house: crisp grooves, warm melodies and hazy breaks, released via Amadeus Records and Duality Trax.

artist_notes.name: Gene On Earth
artist_notes.note: San Francisco-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Eugene Albert) — runs the Limousine Dream label; deep-digging extended sets drifting through minimal house, breaks and hazy late-night rollers.

artist_notes.name: Chemtrail Johnny
artist_notes.note: SoCal DJ/producer working in minimal, laid-back house and techno grooves — low profile but a real local scene name.

artist_notes.name: Hazy
artist_notes.note: Recurring Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house sets, a regular on the rotation at the series' open-airs.

artist_notes.name: Ian Llorens
artist_notes.note: Certified Groovers resident, LA-based (Puerto Rico-born) — rhythm-forward house/techno selector, also plays as O God / Soundprism.

artist_notes.name: Gilbert0
artist_notes.note: Another Certified Groovers regular — same all-vinyl deep-house lane, secret-location DTLA parties.

enrichment.curator_note: This is the TBA-warehouse afterhours format Ari already likes, and the lineup is a notch deeper than most of them — Momo Trosman and Cromie are legit diggers, not just names filling a flyer.
enrichment.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours (10pm-8am) with tech-house/breaks selectors Gene On Earth, Momo Trosman, Cromie, Chemtrail Johnny, Hazy, Ian Llorens and Gilbert0.

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: DJ Holographic
artist_notes.note: Detroit DJ/producer (Ariel Corley) blending house, disco, Motown, and techno — 2025 debut album 'House In The Dark' leans into Afrofuturism; praised by Carl Craig and The Blessed Madonna, has played Panorama Bar and Smart Bar.

artist_notes.name: Anastazja
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ (USC grad) who came up through Soulection Radio, played Boiler Room, and recently supported Keinemusik's Rampa — a credential that tracks with the melodic/Keinemusik lane.

artist_notes.name: Colored Craig
artist_notes.note: LA DJ known for soul/funk/jack-leaning house sets — a regular guest at A Club Called Rhonda over the years.

artist_notes.name: Gay Felony
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer (Melody Scallion) — extended vinyl sets ranging from soulful/progressive house to hard house and melodic techno; hosts a Dublab radio show.

artist_notes.name: Goddollars
artist_notes.note: Loren Granich — Rhonda's own co-founder/resident, playing the sexy house-and-disco sound the party was built around.

artist_notes.name: A Club Called Rhonda

artist_notes.name: SG Lewis
artist_notes.note: British DJ/producer/songwriter — warm, disco-etched dance-pop (albums 'times', 'AudioLust & HigherLove'); has written and produced with Dua Lipa, Robyn and Nile Rodgers.

artist_notes.name: Hot Chip
artist_notes.note: Long-running London electronic band (since 2000, early DFA ties) — dance-rock/electropop ('Over and Over,' 'Ready For The Floor') with a big, festival-tested live show.

artist_notes.name: Austin Millz
artist_notes.note: Harlem-raised, NYC-based DJ/producer blending hip-hop with dance/house — DJ'd Beyoncé's 'Homecoming' Coachella sets and played Boiler Room NYC.

artist_notes.name: Nala
artist_notes.note: LA-via-Miami producer/DJ (Stefania Aronin) — acid house and indie-dance with a punky, off-kilter edge; Dirtybird signee and Lights Down Low resident who runs the label Mi Domina.

artist_notes.name: Blond:ish
artist_notes.note: Canadian-Swiss duo (Anstascia, Vivie-Ann) — melodic/organic house with an eco-conscious rave ethos; co-founded the No.19 Music label.

artist_notes.name: Poolside
artist_notes.note: LA duo (Filip Nikolic, Jeffrey Paradise) who more or less invented 'daytime disco' — slow-motion, sun-baked grooves ('Harvest Moon,' 'Do You Believe'). About as squarely built for a beach day as it gets.

artist_notes.name: Good Neighbours
artist_notes.note: UK indie-pop duo (Oli Fox, Scott Verrill) behind 2024's viral hit 'Home' — tropical-leaning, early-2000s-indie-indebted pop, more festival crossover than club.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden

events.title: Boiler Room: LA | Sunday
reasons: +4 event card (+3 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Floorplan
artist_notes.note: Robert Hood & daughter Lyric Hood — Detroit techno royalty (M-Plant) turned deep, gospel-inflected house. 'Baby Baby' fills a floor for a reason.

artist_notes.name: HoneyLuv
artist_notes.note: Cleveland-born, ex-Navy — one of the biggest tech-house breakouts of the last few years; soulful, groovy end of the genre, runs her own 4 Tha Luv label.

artist_notes.name: Hannah Laing
artist_notes.note: Dundee DJ, ex-dental technician turned fast-rising UK name — high-energy trance and hard house, runs the doof label and just launched her own festival.

artist_notes.name: Coco & Breezy
artist_notes.note: Twin sisters (also the eyewear-brand founders) turned house/dance DJ duo — danceable, R&B-tinged, more crossover-pop energy than underground.

artist_notes.name: STRAWBRY
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture (South Florida-raised) — breaks-and-house sets, runs the STUDIO5400 party series.

artist_notes.name: Vieze Asbak
artist_notes.note: Dutch 'memecore'/troll-rave artist out of Amsterdam's Pestcore Collectief — hard-dance-adjacent chaos, not clean house or techno. A sign this bill gets weird in spots.

artist_notes.name: Jazzy (IRL)
artist_notes.note: Couldn't pin down a confident bio for this one — flagging as unverified rather than guessing.

enrichment.curator_note: Boiler Room's Sunday day party stacks Floorplan's gospel house and HoneyLuv's tech-house heat against Hannah Laing's hard-house hype and a Dutch memecore act, with several names even RA barely has bios for — genuinely one of the most eclectic single-day bills on the radar, go in expecting variety over consistency.
enrichment.description: Boiler Room's LA day party (venue TBA) — a 14-act, multi-genre bill headlined by Floorplan, HoneyLuv, and Hannah Laing.

THE OUTSIDERS navigates the complexities of self- discovery as the Greasers dream about who they want to become in a world that may never accept them. events.title: [CANCELLED] Marques Wyatt B2B Doc Martin - Imagine Luv presents: A Celebration of House Music
events.genre: deep house, tech house, progressive house
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Marques Wyatt
artist_notes.note: West Coast deep house legend — ran LA's long-running Deep party/residency from the late '90s into the 2010s and is generally credited with helping put LA's dance scene on the map alongside NYC and Miami.

artist_notes.name: Doc Martin
artist_notes.note: West Coast house pioneer — moved SF to LA in the early '90s, founded the long-running Sublevel label/party (25 years deep in 2026); deep, tribal, acid-inflected house from a genuine scene elder.

artist_notes.name: David Harness
artist_notes.note: Bay Area deep-house DJ/producer/remixer (credits with Mary J. Blige, Alicia Keys) — soulful, classic house across Coachella, Glastonbury and beyond.

artist_notes.name: Big Cee
artist_notes.note: Chris Legaspi — the longtime resident opening DJ at Marques Wyatt's DEEP, a foundational figure in LA's house community who's shared decks with Frankie Knuckles and Louie Vega.

artist_notes.name: SEEPS
artist_notes.note: Bronx-born, LA-based DJ steeped in NYC's '90s golden-era house and disco/boogie — has drawn attention from Louie Vega and DJ Sneak.

enrichment.curator_note: Marques Wyatt and Doc Martin are the two guys most responsible for LA having a real deep-house scene in the first place, and a b2b between them at an open-air DTLA plaza with Big Cee and SEEPS behind them is about as authentic as this town's house lineage gets.
enrichment.description: Outdoor day party (1pm-9pm) at California Plaza with LA deep-house legends Marques Wyatt b2b Doc Martin, plus David Harness, Big Cee and SEEPS.

artist_notes.name: Anfisa Letyago
artist_notes.note: Naples-scene-turned-global techno DJ/producer (Russian-born, Italy-based) — hypnotic, groove-driven techno/house; Moby tapped her for a 2022 'Go' remix, and she runs her own label N:S:DA.

enrichment.curator_note: A real international techno headliner landing in a proper DTLA room on her own night, not sharing a festival stage — worth the Saturday if you're in a techno mood.
enrichment.description: Solo headline techno set from Italy-based DJ/producer Anfisa Letyago at Exchange LA.

events.title: Bonnie Raitt: Live 2026 with Special Guest Jon Cleary
lineup: Jon Cleary & the Absolute Monster Gentlemen
events.detail: Bluesy singer/songwriter Bonnie Raitt has worked long and hard for her multiple Grammy Awards, hit singles and chart-topping records. Since her 1971 eponymous debut, the California-born performer and long-time activist has steadily maintained a music career, albeit with definite peaks and valleys. The red-headed songstress, one of the only women of her time to play guitar using the bottleneck technique, unleashed seven albums in just nine years, though her big commercial break came with her 10th studio set, 1989’s “Nick of Time.” That 11-track collection, produced by Don Was, earned three Grammy Awards, including Album of the Year. Not only has the Rock and Roll Hall of Famer tackled multiple U.S. tours and international runs, but she’s also a frequent participant in events of social activism, such as Farm Aid and Amnesty International concerts. Raitt’s 16th full-length album and most recent studio release, “Slipstream,” hit retailers in 2012. Not only did ticket sales for the support tour soar, but Raitt also landed the best-selling blues album of the year and took home the Grammy for Best Americana Album.

enrichment.curator_note: A legit deep-techno afterhours booking — Berlin's Blazej Malinowski and Oslo's Kameliia flying in alongside LA's own Anastasia Giovani and Secus for a 5am TBA start. events.title: The Who's Tommy (Touring)
events.detail: In 1969, The Who created a rock opera that changed the course of music history. And now,it’s back in a dazzling all-new production that feels more relevant than ever.Myth and spectacle combine in this fresh reinvention that includes the unforgettable anthems “I’m Free,” “See Me, Feel Me,” “Sensation” and “Pinball Wizard.” After witnessing his father shoot his rival, the young Tommy Walker is lost in the universe, endlessly and obsessively staring into the mirror. An innate knack for pinball catapults him from reticent adolescent to celebrity savior. Tony Award-winning composer Pete Townshend and Tony Award-winning original director Des McAnuff find powerful resonance reexamining this classic story for today.

artist_notes.name: ANOTR
artist_notes.note: Amsterdam tech-house duo (Jesse van der Heijden & Oguzhan Guney), founders of the No Art label/collective and behind the global hit "Relax My Eyes" — one of the biggest tech-house exports in Europe right now, squarely mainstream-festival-scale.

enrichment.curator_note: ANOTR is a legit big-room tech-house draw right now, and Factory 93 putting it under the 6th Street Bridge is a real venue flex — this is the mainstream-headliner-that-still-counts lane, not filler.
enrichment.description: Factory 93 hosts Dutch tech-house duo ANOTR (No Art) at Ace/Mission Studios under the 6th Street Bridge in DTLA.

artist_notes.note: Baltimore funk/jam band — extended improvisational jams over a funk-rock base, built around a dedicated touring jam-scene fanbase rather than club culture.

enrichment.curator_note: This is a proper jam band, not remotely house or techno, but Teragram is one of the better small rooms in the city for a live set and a funk-forward jam show there on a Friday is a fine change of pace if you're not chasing a DJ that night.

events.title: Slaughterhäus: The La Cut - Los Angeles

enrichment.curator_note: The name and TBA-warehouse-DTLA setup scream hard-techno rave branding, but with zero lineup posted on RA there's no one to actually vouch for here.
enrichment.description: TBA-location warehouse party in DTLA, part of the Slaughterhäus 'La Cut' series; no lineup announced.

artist_notes.name: Richie Hawtin
artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers.

artist_notes.name: DJ Tennis
artist_notes.note: Manfredi Romano — Italian scene godfather who founded Life and Death in 2010 (Tale Of Us, Mind Against and Carlita all came up through the label); a globally touring, melodic house/techno selector.

artist_notes.name: Adam Ten
artist_notes.note: Israeli-born, Amsterdam-based producer — half of Adam Ten & Mita Gami, the melodic house/techno duo who took over Coachella's Yuma Tent two weekends running in 2024; co-founder of the Maccabi House movement.

artist_notes.name: Avalon Emerson
artist_notes.note: American techno/house DJ-producer (SF by way of Berlin) — melodic, songwriterly club techno (the Whities-era singles, her '&More' LP); a genuine global-circuit headliner.

artist_notes.name: Kana Hishiya
artist_notes.note: Japan-born, LA-based DJ/producer — house and techno moving between punchy, minimal and broken-beat, with dreamy melodic turns; played MEOKO and Sirens LA podcast series.

artist_notes.name: Maddix
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer known for a hard-hitting techno/big-room/trance crossover (breakout track 'Ecstasy'), Revealed Recordings-affiliated. Mainstage-built and harder-edged than the refined techno end of the lane (Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens) — closer to festival trance-techno.

enrichment.curator_note: Insomniac's Halloween mega-fest buries real house/techno headliners — Hawtin, Kraviz, Capriati, DJ Tennis, Jamie Jones — under a dozen stages of hardstyle, dubstep, and bass. Worth it for a specific set, not for the vibe of the thing as a whole.
enrichment.description: Insomniac's Halloween festival at NOS Events Center in San Bernardino, spanning house/techno headliners (Richie Hawtin, Nina Kraviz, Joseph Capriati) alongside trance, dubstep, and hardstyle stages.

enrichment.curator_note: No lineup posted yet for this Halloween-week booking — 1720 is a dependable warehouse-techno room, but hard to rate blind at $46.
enrichment.description: Halloween-week party at 1720 in the Arts District; lineup not yet announced.

artist_notes.note: American techno/house DJ-producer (SF by way of Berlin) — melodic, songwriterly club techno (the Whities-era singles, her '&More' LP); a genuine global-circuit headliner.

artist_notes.name: Sextile
artist_notes.note: LA synth-punk/EBM band (Sacred Bones) that's leaned harder into techno and rave sounds on its newest record — gothy, driving, club-adjacent post-punk; DJ set here rather than live.

artist_notes.name: Ellen Allien
artist_notes.note: Berlin techno pioneer and BPitch Control label founder since the '90s — raw, physical, art-damaged techno; about as European-scene as a booking gets.

artist_notes.name: Effy
artist_notes.note: UK (Blackpool/London) DJ-producer doing druggy acid techno and classic-house revivalism — has opened for Helena Hauff, Scuba, Honey Dijon and Peggy Gou.

artist_notes.name: Johnny_Health
artist_notes.note: LA underground rave-circuit DJ (Hood Rave/Hellraiser-type parties) — thin bio beyond a busy local DJ résumé.

artist_notes.name: Richie Panic
artist_notes.note: Founder of Lights Down Low (also Frisco Disco, Blow Up) — the LA promoter behind this exact series, known for genre-blurring 'weird' house and techno bills.

artist_notes.name: Corey Sizemore
artist_notes.note: LA/SF DJ, co-founder and resident of Lights Down Low alongside Richie Panic; eclectic house-and-techno sets, Boiler Room alum.

enrichment.curator_note: Ellen Allien and Avalon Emerson on the same Halloween bill is a real techno booking, not a costume-party gimmick — and Lights Down Low's own crew (Richie Panic, Corey Sizemore) plus Sextile's DJ set keep it weird instead of trick-or-treat cute.
enrichment.description: Lights Down Low's Halloween all-nighter (TBA location, 9pm-4am) stacks Berlin techno legend Ellen Allien and Avalon Emerson with Sextile's DJ set and the LDL residents.

enrichment.curator_note: Certified Groovers usually books real deep-house names (DJ Sneak, Mark Farina, Doc Martin, Chez Damier have all played the series) — no lineup posted yet for this Halloween edition, but the promoter's track record makes it worth watching for an announcement.
enrichment.description: Certified Groovers' Halloween Party at a TBA Downtown LA location — no lineup announced yet (10pm, Oct 31).

artist_notes.name: Brijean
artist_notes.note: Oakland duo (Brijean Murphy & Doug Stuart) on Ghostly International — Murphy is also the touring percussionist for Poolside and Toro y Moi; their own sound is warm, congas-driven boogie/dream-pop. This is a DJ set, not the live band, so expect disco/house selections in that same breezy register.

enrichment.curator_note: Brijean behind the decks rather than behind the congas is a nice change of format — her Ghostly/Poolside pedigree suggests a warm, disco-leaning selection for a Halloween night at Camille's.
enrichment.description: Halloween DJ set (disco/house/pop) from Ghostly International duo Brijean at The Bellwether's Camille's night.

artist_notes.name: Giegling
artist_notes.note: The Weimar, Germany label/collective (Traumprinz aka DJ Metatron, Konstantin/Kettenkarussell, Vril, HVL and others) behind some of the most mythologized, hypnotic house and techno of the last decade — genuinely rare to see a Giegling-branded date in LA, though the listing doesn't say which member of the crew is actually playing.

enrichment.curator_note: A Giegling booking in LA is unusual enough to flag even without knowing which artist from the crew is actually behind the decks — TBA location and a 6am run time both point to the real afterhours version of this, from the same Midnight Lovers crew as Masha Mar's other nights.
enrichment.description: Halloween afterhours party (TBA DTLA location, 11pm-6am) presented by Midnight Lovers under the Giegling banner.

artist_notes.name: Dave Aju
artist_notes.note: SF producer (Marc Barrite) and longtime Circus Company artist — soulful, left-field minimal house built from his own vocals and samples; played Fabric, Panorama Bar and Rex Club. A genuinely deep booking for a Halloween party.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector out of the '90s UK queer rave scene — house/techno/disco marathon sets and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator/muse.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: Tavish
artist_notes.note: Venice-native LA warehouse-scene DJ (also a Grammy-winning producer as half of Sid Roams) — industrial disco and acid house; a fixture across the city's underground circuit alongside names like Psychemagik and DJ Garth.

artist_notes.name: Things You Say
artist_notes.note: LA club-scene DJ project posting house mixes and playing local nights — low profile, nothing more substantial to verify beyond that.

enrichment.curator_note: Yamashiro's hillside gardens plus a genuinely deep bill — Dave Aju's Circus Company pedigree next to Heidi Lawden and Masha Mar's disco digging — makes this a rare Halloween party actually worth dressing up for.
enrichment.description: Halloween costume party in Yamashiro's hillside gardens with house/disco DJs Dave Aju, Heidi Lawden, Masha Mar, Tavish and Things You Say.

events.title: Midnight Lovers Invites Dekmantel Soundsystem & Make A Dance
Sneak's Birthday Beats 2026: Derrick Carter, DJ Sneak, DJ Heather, H-Foundation, Hector Moralez, J-Dub, Juliet Mendoza, Masha Mar, Ian Llorens, Stacy Christine, Tom Carle, Your Unkle Magik
events.genre: funky house, jackin house, deep house, tech house

artist_notes.name: Mark Farina
artist_notes.note: Chicago-born, SF-based house legend behind the long-running 'Mushroom Jazz' series — a jazzy, downtempo-inflected strain of house he's been refining since the mid-90s.

artist_notes.name: Josh Wink
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia techno/house legend ('Higher State of Consciousness') and Ovum Recordings co-founder since 1994 — still a headline-level booking three decades in.

artist_notes.name: DJ Dazy
artist_notes.note: LA house DJ since 1992 — founded the all-female Sister DJs collective, deep and soulful vinyl-rooted sets, part of the West Coast house lineage this bill leans on.

artist_notes.name: Your Unkle Magik
artist_notes.note: Vinyl-only house selector, a regular on the Certified Groovers/DTLA open-air circuit.

artist_notes.name: Tom Carle
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ working deep/minimal tech-house and techno — longtime host of a DJ podcast since 2018, regular alongside DJ Sneak and J-Dub on the CHI♡LA circuit.

artist_notes.name: Derrick Carter
artist_notes.note: Chicago house legend since the late-'80s Warehouse/Muzic Box lineage — co-runs Classic Music Company with Luke Solomon; funky, genre-agnostic, unmistakable house selection still headlining at this level.

artist_notes.name: DJ Heather
artist_notes.note: Chicago house DJ, co-founder of the pioneering all-female Superjane crew (with DJ Colette, Dayhota, Lady D) — soulful, genre-blurring sets rooted in Gramaphone Records digging.

artist_notes.name: John Tejada
artist_notes.note: Vienna-born, LA-based since childhood — Palette Recordings founder and a fixture of musical, melodic techno/deep house since the mid-90s (Kompakt, Pokerflat, Cocoon). Real underground pedigree headlining his own night.

artist_notes.name: DJ Sneak
artist_notes.note: Chicago house OG ('the Turntable Terrorist') — jacking, sample-heavy garage-house going back to the early-'90s Cajmere/Relief era, still DJing at that level today.

artist_notes.name: H-Foundation
artist_notes.note: San Diego duo (Hipp-E & Halo) — dub-inflected deep/tech-house with a Fabric London residency and a Chemical Brothers remix credit to their name; not a frequent LA booking.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector who cut her teeth in the '90s UK queer rave scene — house/techno/disco marathon sets (an 8-hour solo warehouse set till 8am) and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator/muse. Also on the Defected boardwalk afterparty this batch.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: Hector Moralez
artist_notes.note: Oakland-raised, now LA-based house DJ/producer (Minority Music, The Factory labels) — Chicago/Detroit-rooted, soul-deep selections; a regular in Sneak's LA circle.

artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: LA-native house DJ and dancer — founder/resident of Jill's House (Jackin Jills), a Defected 'Unsung Heroes' alum; melodic, soulful, deep house rooted in the city's Black/Latin house dance lineage.

artist_notes.name: Dj Kerry
artist_notes.note: LA DJ since 2005, longtime Dublab radio host and founder of The Basement, a membership-based party rooted in Paradise Garage/West Coast warehouse tradition.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control, Machine Club lineage) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

artist_notes.name: J-Dub
artist_notes.note: Chicago-bred new-school house DJ and frequent DJ Sneak collaborator on the LA circuit (CHI♡LA, Certified Groovers) — funky, percussive, seamless-blend style.

artist_notes.name: Ian Llorens
artist_notes.note: Certified Groovers resident, LA-based (Puerto Rico-born) — rhythm-forward house/techno selector, also plays as O God / Soundprism.

enrichment.curator_note: A three-day house marathon built around DJ Sneak's birthday with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina and Josh Wink on the bill — this is Chicago-house royalty depth you don't see stacked this thick very often, TBA location aside.
enrichment.description: Multi-day (Sat 4pm–Mon 2am) house celebration for DJ Sneak's birthday, TBA location, with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina, Josh Wink, DJ Heather, John Tejada and a deep bench of Chicago-rooted house DJs.

artist_notes.name: Ferry Corsten
artist_notes.note: Dutch trance OG since the late-90s boom (System F, Gouryella with a young Tiësto) who now runs his own Flashover label and plays a broader, more contemporary progressive-leaning set.

artist_notes.name: Artbat
artist_notes.note: Ukrainian duo (Artur Kryvenko & Vitalii Limarenko) — melodic techno breakout via Solomun's Diynamic label ('Upperground', 'Atlas'); one of the names most responsible for melodic techno's mainstream crossover.

artist_notes.name: Enrico Sangiuliano
artist_notes.note: Italian techno producer, one of Drumcode's biggest-selling artists for a stretch (Adam Beyer's label) — hypnotic, sci-fi-tinged peak-time techno built for big rooms.

artist_notes.name: BT
artist_notes.note: Brian Transeau — one of American trance's founding names since the late-90s, still touring a big, cinematic, melody-forward sound.

artist_notes.name: Hannah Laing
artist_notes.note: Scottish DJ/producer on the UK hard-house/hardcore-revival wave — high-BPM, rave-nostalgic tech house.

artist_notes.name: Pegassi
artist_notes.note: Belgian producer (Sam Huybrecht) running his own label/party series Sweet Nothing — a deliberately 'post-genre' set that swings between trance, techno, eurodance and house rather than staying in a lane. Closer to a big-room selector than a groove/disco DJ.

enrichment.curator_note: Trance is mostly outside the lane, but this is the genre's biggest annual SoCal gathering, and Artbat and Enrico Sangiuliano's melodic-techno sets are a real reason to go beyond nostalgia for Above & Beyond and Ferry Corsten.
enrichment.description: Insomniac's SoCal trance festival, headlined by Above & Beyond and Ferry Corsten with melodic-techno crossover sets from Artbat and Enrico Sangiuliano.
